title: Your *chores* predicted your life better than IQ

text: 456 boys from Boston's poorest areas, followed from 14 to 47. Boys who *did chores and odd jobs* grew into better men.

label: THE RESULT
head: Healthier minds. Better relationships.
sub: It mattered more than IQ or family money.

items.head: No dishes in the sink
items.sub: Wash it the moment you use it.

label: THE DEAL
head: Chores first. Then you earn the fun.
sub: Friday night is yours once the list is done.
